versions.content: Support of dynamic length DIDs On reception of the UDS Ser- vice ReadDataByPeriodicIdentifier (0x2A), for every requested periodicDIDs, with a configured dynamic length the Dcm module shall invoke the ReadDataLength opera- tion (or the respective C-Function) to retrieve the length of the periodicDID. This length is valid for each ReadData operation till the periodicDID is removed from the scheduler or updated via a new request. This length shall further be used to check against the UUDT size.
